intro: Across government, technology, enterprise, critical infrastructure, and federal government, ZCyberNews has tracked 19 articles on the CISA KEV catalog between 2026-04-19 and 2026-10-14. Flax Typhoon features among the threat actors tied to these entries. The most severe CVEs include CVE-2015-3306, CVE-2026-20079, and CVE-2026-48907, each rated CVSS 10, alongside CVE-2023-49105 and CVE-2025-39682 at CVSS 9.8. Coverage spans the United states, Global, North america, the EU, and Europe. The severity mix comprises 5 high, 8 critical, and 2 medium items.
